title: JTAG TAP Controller
constraints: Implement the 16-state IEEE 1149.1 TAP state machine, clocked by the rising edge of `tck` and steered by `tms`.
Use the state encoding in the table (it is the standard's recommended assignment). `state` outputs it directly.
`trst` is a synchronous reset to Test-Logic-Reset (real TAPs reset asynchronously, simplified here).
Moore decodes: `shift_dr`, `shift_ir`, `capture_dr`, `update_dr` and `tlr` are 1 exactly in the states with those names. Must be synthesizable.
hints: Write the transition table as a `case` on the state, with `tms ? next1 : next0` per state.
Key property: from **any** state, five consecutive `tms = 1` edges reach Test-Logic-Reset. Use it to sanity-check your table.
The DR and IR columns of the diagram are identical in shape. Only Select-IR-Scan's `tms = 1` exit (to Test-Logic-Reset) is different.

examples.title: five ones
examples.input: tms = 1 for 5 edges from any state
